children: News Corp updated its US$1 billion 2025 repurchase program, disclosing approximately US$463.3 million deployed to date and US$301.26 million purchased on Sept. 4, 2026.
Company authorized to repurchase up to US$1 billion of Class A and Class B stock under the 2025 Repurchase Program.
To date the program has purchased about US$463,311,435 of Class A and Class B shares (based on total consideration paid).
On Sept. 4, 2026 the company bought back 11,614,809 shares for US$301,262,219.93 (Class A listing shows this amount).
Daily notifications to ASX show additional Sept. 4 buys across classes: 5,424,319 shares for US$159,563,617.29 and other tranches noted.
Repurchases are intended to enhance shareholder value; purchases occur subject to market conditions and may vary.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
